item.title: Long Car Ride to Grandma's? Printable Travel Activities That Don't Make Kids Carsick
item.description: Looking down at a page is what makes many kids queasy in the car. Six eyes-up printable games for the road, which pages to save for rest stops, what to pack, and what to do when a child starts to feel sick.
